extraction_quality_notes: Blind extraction intentionally omits expected-manifold fields, paper diagnosis-label fields, final diagnosis fields, and paper-title-derived diagnosis evidence.
Rankable initial observations are limited to demographics-linked presentation, history context, admission symptoms/absences, physical examination, ECG, HRCT/MRA, ultrasound, and initial labs.
Course observations are objective facts from May 8-9 before thrombolysis, represented with diagnosis-neutral axis IDs and temporal_context.

Treatment, thrombolysis, anticoagulation, diagnostic interpretations, post-treatment response, discharge course, late cerebral hemorrhage, and discussion-level causal framing are record-only with use_in_ranking=false.
D-dimer unit is ambiguous because the source reports microg/ml without specifying FEU versus DDU.
The source abbreviates troponin as Tn and does not specify troponin I versus troponin T.
The source says creatine kinase isozyme; it was mapped to serum_ck_mb because the units/range fit CK-MB, but the exact subtype is not spelled out.
No respiratory rate, oxygen saturation, body temperature, platelet count, PT/INR, arterial blood gas, lactate, creatinine, or lower-limb thrombus size is reported in the extracted full text.
